text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

1. **#PD-4492** (Eau Claire kiosk SMS bay assignments, Dock Doors 14-18). Source: `teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`.
2. **#4419** (gatehouse barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14). Source: `teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`, the undated cheat sheet.

The other two QFL digests have no ticket number. Marcus's public Q2 expansion note also cites #4419, but describes it as Gate 3 printer lag, which doesn't match the cheat sheet. I left it out of the list because it isn't Moss's note, and I flagged the mismatch in the DM. Confirm with Thea or Support which issue #4419 is before it goes in the weekly notes.

I haven't written anything to the weekly notes.
